request: Check all project references and Docker mounts to old GPG-Core, no secret content

bounded_host_request.command: python3 -c 'import os,subprocess,json; r=subprocess.run(["docker","ps","-q"],capture_output=True,text=True); p=subprocess.run(["docker","inspect",*r.stdout.split()],capture_output=True,text=True) if r.stdout.strip() else None; j=json.loads(p.stdout) if p and p.returncode==0 else []; print("GPG_DOCKER_MOUNTS",[(v["Name"],m["Source"]) for v in j for m in v["Mounts"] if "GPG-Core" in m["Source"]]);base="/home/admin1/projects"; roots=[os.path.join(base,n) for n in os.listdir(base) if n!="GPG-Core" and os.path.isdir(os.path.join(base,n))];q=subprocess.run(["grep","-RIlE","GPG-Core|secure_up.sh|gpg_core",*roots,"--exclude-dir=.git","--exclude-dir=node_modules","--exclude-dir=.worktrees","--exclude-dir=artifacts","--exclude-dir=dist","--exclude-dir=venv"],capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=35);print("LEGACY_CODE_REFS",q.stdout.splitlines()[:70],"TOTAL",len(q.stdout.splitlines()),"RC",q.returncode)'
